title: Ou Ou Wants to Have Friends
summary: Ou Ou the little porcupine loves to sing, dance and play. But he doesn't like his sharp quills, because of them nobody wants to play with him. A little mouse sees that Ou Ou is a good friend and that his quills aren't scary. Will the other animals see it too?
pages: Ou Ou, the little porcupine, loves to dance, sing and play.
What he doesn't like are the sharp quills all over his body. They get in the way of his fun!
Nobody else likes them either. At the playground, nobody wants to play with him.
At camp, nobody wants to sleep in the tent with him. "Don't sleep with us, Ou Ou," they complain. "Your quills will poke us."
One day, a little mouse comes up to him and says, "Ou Ou, your quills make you special."
The little mouse wants to help, so he sews Ou Ou a special shirt.
Ou Ou puts on the shirt and goes out to meet the other animals. "Don't come near us! We're scared of the sharp quills on your back," they say. "What quills?" asks Ou Ou. "I don't have any at all."
The other animals laugh, and Ou Ou sees that his quills have poked holes right through his special new shirt. Ou Ou is sad, and he goes back to his only friend, the little mouse.
"Don't worry, my prickly friend," says the little mouse. "I have another idea."
"What are you doing?" asks Ou Ou. "Wait and see, Ou Ou," says the little mouse.
"Now let's go meet the other animals," says the little mouse. Ou Ou is excited to show everyone his new quills.
Everyone comes to admire Ou Ou's colorful new quills, and very soon they realize that the quills aren't so scary after all. "Sorry, Ou Ou," they say.
And they all go off to play together.
